descFull: The open platform for AI on your cameras: a self-hosted NVR (ONVIF/RTSP, recording, WebRTC) running any AI model through one open contract, with an app SDK and one-click apps. New capabilities arrive as software, not new boxes. Air-gapped or connected, audited end to end. Home Assistant built in. AGPLv3. A Frigate/ZoneMinder alternative.
